guarantees.claim: unused_entropy_input is continuously driven to equal entropy_i.
unused_entropy_mode is continuously driven to equal entropy_mode.
unused_entropy_fast_process is continuously driven to equal entropy_fast_process.
entropy_o is always driven to an all-zeros vector.

uncertain_points.claim: entropy_o is forced to zero; it is unclear whether this is an intentional deactivation (entropy unused) or a placeholder that should deliver actual entropy.
uncertain_points.risk: If KMAC relies on entropy for masking or randomness, feeding zero breaks security properties (e.g., side-channel resistance, algorithmic randomness).

uncertain_points.claim: unused_entropy_input, unused_entropy_mode, and unused_entropy_fast_process appear to exist only for lint suppression; they may never be read elsewhere.
uncertain_points.risk: If these signals are never consumed, any required entropy connections might be unintentionally left open without obvious functional failure.
